records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Enterprise operating revenues increased $82.8 million, approximately 6%, in the first quarter of 2025 compared to the same quarter in 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •a $75.6 million increase in Truckload segment revenues (excluding fuel surcharge) due to Dedicated volume growth driven by the Cowan acquisition and increased Network and Dedicated rates, offset by decreased Network volumes;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Purchased transportation decreased $23.3 million, or 5%, quarter over quarter, resulting from declines in owner-operator capacity within Truckload (partially offset by the impacts of the Cowan acquisition) and lower third-party carrier costs within Logistics driven by lower purchased transportation costs per order and volume, partially offset by the Cowan acquisition.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating expenses tend to be higher in the winter months, primarily due to colder weather, which causes higher maintenance expense and higher fuel consumption from increased idle time.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Enterprise net income increased $7.6 million, approximately 41%, in the first quarter of 2025 compared to the same quarter in 2024, primarily due to a $13.4 million increase in income from operations.
